integrity: The upper bound is an exact rational certificate checked on all 64 ambient words; the lower bound is an explicit seven-word code whose complete two-deletion output multiplicities are regenerated by the included verifier.
scientific_limitations: The exact extremal value is proved only for binary length six with two deletions and list size two; no claim is made for other lengths or list sizes.
title: Exact length-six binary two-list two-deletion code size
